Manchester property tax is billed by the offices named below.

Who bills what in Manchester

  • City of Manchester Board of Assessors handles assessment.
  • City of Manchester Office of the Tax Collector bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

Two bills a year: first bill mailed end of May/early June and due 30 days after; second (final) bill mailed mid to end of November and due 30 days after. Interest 8% per annum after the due date (RSA 76:13). Rate is issued by NH DRA in Oct/Nov.. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Written Abatement Application to the Board of Assessors, received or postmarked on or before March 1 after the final tax bill; cannot be filed online (original signature needed). Appeal to NH BTLA in writing by Sept 1 (fee) or to Hillsborough County Superior Court, Northern District, by Sept 1; BTLA appeal waives superior court.. See the official page.

Tax rate

The official page we opened lists 2025 property tax rate 20.24 per $1,000 (page table; Central Business Service District rate 0.462730). See the official page.

Local notes

  • Hillsborough County.
Behind on Manchester property tax?

Get My Cash Offer →

Manchester by the numbers

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts about 115,415 people in Manchester, which makes it the 1st largest of the 5 nh places we cover. The median value of an owner-occupied home is $336,300, 0% above the median of those 5 places. 49% of occupied homes are owner-occupied and 51% are rented, against a median of 56% owner-occupancy across the nh places. The median home was built in 1964, about 59 years ago, which matters for roofs, plumbing and inspection requests. These numbers describe Manchester as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
